variants.after: Trading your future for the almoner's silence means you must stay entirely unseen, making these undocumented subterranean routes vital to outrunning your rapidly accumulating debts.
Bloodstains from the almoner's fatal fall remain crusted on your knuckles, making a quiet, unseen route beneath the streets far more appealing than facing the enraged constabulary above.
Squinting at the canvas, you pull the disgraced tailor's coat tighter, grateful that its unassuming cut blends so naturally into the bohemian clutter of the turpentine-soaked studio.
The artist casts a disdainful glance at your coarse canvas porter's livery, clearly doubting whether a common coal-hauler possesses the coin required for such specialised architectural secrets.
Tarnished brass buttons on your opera usher's uniform catch the studio lamplight, prompting a raised eyebrow from the painter who rarely sees such theatrical finery down in his cramped workspace.
Because your exact features have been circulated to the guards and great houses alike, slipping into these proposed meetings as an anonymous shadow will be nearly impossible.
Knowing the grandmaster's lock on the undervault below has already been shattered by your hand, you realise the factions summoning you are likely negotiating over a compromised prize.
Distant whistles from the cathedral confirm the almoner has unleashed the watch, meaning Matron Rigg's catchpoles are sweeping the streets below while you linger dangerously on the slates.
